sub_sector.value: Engineered plumbing; drinking water fixtures; washroom products

manufacturing_type.detail: Makes individual building products such as filtered bottle fillers, water coolers, sinks and condensing tankless water heaters.

product_complexity.detail: Engineered products manage drainage, regulate water pressure, protect public water supplies and provide hygienic hand drying.

production_role.detail: Supplies finished plumbing products, drinking water fixtures, washroom partitions and lockers, and residential kitchen appliances.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves commercial construction and retrofits, industrial facilities, healthcare settings, residential consumers and municipal water applications.

notes: The evidence leaves production timing unclear.
